justification: Holy cow, we're runnin it back nearly wire to wire, folks! Lamar's got a Questionable tag next to his name but a little rain never hurt anybody and that man's a Louisville thoroughbred, he's slingin it Sunday. Bijan Robinson dropped THIRTY-FOUR on us last week, you do not touch a hot bat like that, he's locked in RB1 no matter who New Orleans sends out there. D'Andre Swift's my guy out of Chicago and you know Old Harry's got a soft spot a mile wide for a Bear, he rides regardless of the matchup. Zay's Questionable too but he's a Raven and Ravens play through weather, through tags, through everything -- due respect to the training staff. Aaron Jones gets the flex nod over Kamara and the boys on the bench, projections love him and so do I. Diggs is right there at WR2, that man was DUE two weeks back and he came through at 19.2, I'm not yanking him now for a tenth of a point on paper. Hunter Henry's quiet but I like the fella in that uniform, I ain't streamin' tight ends for a point and a half, we stick with our guy. Mevis and the Ravens D round us out. Full lineup, full hearts, let's play ball!
